latest_release.name: v1.13.4: app language, App Store settings restore
latest_release.body:
### Added
- Settings › General › "App language": follow macOS, or pick any language the build ships. The list uses each language's own name, so 简体中文 is findable while the app is in another language. The choice is stored where macOS keeps an app's own language, so it takes effect after Hidden Bar restarts; macOS's per-app language panel writes the same value. The new row is translated in all 13 languages.
- Settings › Advanced › "Restore settings from the App Store version" (direct build): copies the settings the App Store version saved back into this version, any time, after a confirmation. Hidden Bar also keeps a private copy of those settings in `~/Library/Application Support/Hidden Bar/` the first time it can read them, so they stay reachable if macOS later blocks the App Store container or the App Store copy is removed.

### Fixed
- Settings: a long pane no longer cuts off its last rows. The window now measures the pane after its text wraps, and scrolls when the pane is taller than the window. In some languages the Advanced tab hid its bottom row.
- Switching from the App Store version: the import offer can no longer be lost for good. It used to appear once, and only while this version still had default settings. The Accessibility prompt no longer opens over the import alert, and the log now says why the offer did or did not show ("AppStoreMigration: import offer skipped: ...").

detail.readme:
## Hidden Bar Hidden Bar lets you hide menu bar items to give your Mac a cleaner look.

## 🚀 Install > **Official downloads.** Console Labs publishes Hidden Bar only through [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/consolelabs/hidden/releases), the Homebrew cask `hiddenbar`, and the [Mac App Store listing](https://itunes.apple.com/app/hidden-bar/id1452453066). Any other site offering Hidden Bar (for example `hiddenbar.app`) is not run by Console Labs. ###  App Store [![AppStore](img/appstore.svg)](https://itunes.apple.com/app/hidden-bar/id1452453066) The App Store build is sandboxed and cannot hide icons on macOS 27. On macOS 27, use the GitHub or Homebrew build below. ### Others The Hidden Bar is notarized before distributed out side App Store. It's safe to use 👍 #### Using Homebrew ``` brew install --cask hiddenbar ``` Coming from the App Store version? Quit it and move `/Applications/Hidden Bar.app` to the Trash first: Homebrew does not install over it. Your settings stay; the new version offers to import them on first launch. #### Manual download - [Download latest version](https://github.com/consolelabs/hidden/releases/latest) - Open and drag the app to the Applications folder. - Launch Hidden and drag the icon in your menu bar (hold CMD) to the right so it is between some other icons. ## 🕹 Usage * `⌘` + drag to move the Hidden icons around in the menu bar. * Click the Arrow icon to hide menu bar items, and click it again to show them. * Option-click the Arrow to reach the always-hidden section, a second group that stays hidden when you click the arrow. * Settings has the hide delay, a global shortcut, other ways to reveal icons (hover, scroll, shake) and the arrow style.

## 📚 Documentation - [Manual](docs/MANUAL.md): every setting, the hidden Terminal-only options, and troubleshooting. - [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the hiding trick works, topology, and known limits. - [macOS 27 known limits](docs/macos27-known-limits.md): why some menu bar items stay hidden, and the pause switch. - [Maintainer runbook](docs/RUNBOOK.md): build, behavioral verification, and release process. ## ✨Contributors This project exists thanks to all the people who contribute. Thank you guys so much 👏 [![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/0)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/0)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/1)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/1)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/2)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/2)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/3)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/3)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/4)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/4)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/5)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/5)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/6)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/6)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/7)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/7) Please read [this](CONTRIBUTING.md) before you make a contribution. ## Requirements macOS version >= 13.0 (Ventura) Running an older macOS? The last release supporting macOS 10.13 High Sierra through 12 Monterey is [v1.10](https://github.com/consolelabs/hidden/releases/tag/v1.10). Later versions require macOS 13 because autostart moved to the `SMAppService` API introduced there. ## You may also like - [Blurred](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1497527363) - A macOS utility that helps reduce distraction by dimming your inactive noise - [VimMotion](https://github.com/consolelabs/VimMotionApp) Vim style shortcut for MacOS ## License MIT © [Console Labs](https://console.so)
